_source: OpenStreetMap waterways (waterway=river, and named waterway=stream) for the Bataan bounding box, downloaded from the Overpass API on 2026-10-13, clipped to the Bataan land boundary in data/bataan-boundaries.geojson (+0.3 km coastal margin) and simplified to ~8 m. Ways keep OSM direction (drawn downstream, source to mouth). Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Format: {id: OSM way id, n: names, w: waterway type, c: [[lat, lng], ...]}.
